projects.name: Khymera Dashboard
projects.content: A real-time control and telemetry system designed to interact with physical hardware. It acts as the control layer between user intent and robotic systems.
projects.impact: Bridges operators and machines with a single, responsive control surface.

projects.name: Khymera (Robotic gripper / prosthetic)
projects.content: A modular robotic platform focused on accessibility and efficient mechanical design — an attempt to build low-cost, functional prosthetic solutions.

projects.name: Jevil_Tester
projects.content: AI-powered testing system for IoT applications, combining browser automation with embedded test doubles.

projects.name: GETAPRO
projects.content: A platform for managing research and technical projects with real-time collaboration and AI support — designed to reduce friction in complex academic and engineering workflows.
projects.impact: Fewer fragmented tools; clearer workflows for advisors and teams.

projects.name: WTranscriber
projects.content: AI-powered transcription for audio and video, focused on accessibility and fast content processing.
projects.impact: Makes dense audio/video usable as editable text quickly.

projects.name: Custom biomedical & robotics
projects.content: Concepts and prototypes including exosuit architectures and modular prosthetic systems — exploring how software, control systems, and mechanics integrate into assistive technologies.
keyFeatures: Iterative prototyping for assistive use cases
